items.title: Lawrence Douglas Harris Interview, 1961-06-06
items.q: I stayed with Waddell until that band busted up

ctx.x: The guy that left here, Edgar Perry, call him Edgar, Edgar Perry. He had a tremendous, a royal garden band. Royal garden band. Edgar Perry, he was a terrific pianist. I couldn't read a note. No. And so many others. I mean I could name the fellas that I knew around at it, terrific musicians that couldn't read. Well you take for instance the pianist that Pihon had so long, Steve Lewis. Well Steve was, I imagine you recall some of his recordings if you heard them. Well Steve was sincere. I just heard it. He was…

Sure he was. Well I got over there at Wickle and I got with George Carver's band, they were all readers, George could read. We did very good with that band. And while I was there, Wardell, well I'm cutting out a lot of it because I had gone up to Omeon Nebraska and had a band of my own up there in Omeon Nebraska. And I ran into this guy, Nat Tolles. Nat Tolles, he's still on there.
He is from New Orleans. Yeah and Buster and a whole bunch of musicians up there. He is from New Orleans.
